description:
Deterministically review the source of a dashboard or overview before presenting it. For every dashboard, call this after get-review-rules and before check-comprehension. A prose self-review is not a substitute.

Pass the complete page source. The rules follow what the page is built on. A page built on an installed Better Design kit is held to the kit's components: pass the installed Sidebar, StatCard, and Table source files too. A one-file HTML page or another framework is not, and those rules come back as not applicable. Pass `fixture` and `interpretation` only when the request itself supplied them; never write one from the page. Without them the page keeps its own title, actions and structure. The tool fails incomplete source, rewritten fixture copy, unsupported claims, missing or under-composed installed components, raw aside/table markup in a kit page, the wrong scan order, action color on every rate, and stepper rails on short flows.

FAIL is blocking and returns an MCP tool error. Fix every finding and call the tool again until PASS. NOT APPLICABLE is not a failure: keep the page as it is and finish with check-comprehension and inspect-spacing. For a kit dashboard built from a request fixture, call finalize-dashboard-review after PASS; only its VALID source-bound receipt permits presentation.

componentSources.description: Installed Sidebar, StatCard, and Table source files for compound-composition review.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used for usage analytics, and to pick the next step a UI or UX principle answer ends with. It does not change what the tool finds.

fixture.description: Only when the request supplied one: its unchanged fixture object. The first step is the overview; remaining steps are dependent task screens. Omit it when fixing an existing page.

interpretation.description: Only when the request asked for one: the supplied or factually derived takeaway that must appear after records.

screen.description: What this dashboard is, e.g. 'funnel report overview'.

source.description: Complete source for the dashboard page: TSX, JSX, or the whole HTML file.
